scope.assignment: six distinct observed 42-byte chunk ranks assigned to natural columns 0..5
scope.closure: cell closes only if every prefix rejects; otherwise unresolved
scope.constraint: first six natural cells fix nine ciphertext bytes per row; test the ninth CFB8 plaintext byte against A105
scope.endpoint_limit: necessary relaxed byte filter only; retained prefix is not a full order or plaintext
scope.enumeration: complete fresh lexicographic P(13,6) per cell; no cap and no resume
scope.external_iv: every eight-byte IV; neither recovered nor searched
scope.overwrite_policy: refuse any existing cell or combined output
scope.survivors: retain every six-rank prefix and all 28 computed ninth plaintext bytes; independently replay each
scope.variant: inverse byte-unit AMSCO with continuous alternating 1/2-byte cells
